how_to_apply: Eligible candidates can complete their online applications through the UPSSSC website from 3 November to 25 November 2026. Applicants must authenticate themselves using the PET 2025 registration details.
Visit the official UPSSSC website at https://upsssc.gov.in/.
Open the recruitment advertisement for the Combined Junior Engineer (Mechanical) Main Examination (PET-2025)/24.
Enter the PET 2025 registration number and complete OTP-based authentication.
Review the personal details retrieved through PET registration.
Select the appropriate post and complete the required qualification and eligibility details.
Check the photograph, signature and other prefilled information.
Complete the declaration and submit the application details.
Pay the prescribed online processing fee of Rs. 25.
Verify the payment transaction status and complete the fee adjustment process.
Download and retain the submitted application form for future reference.
Important: Candidates must complete the fee adjustment process before the prescribed date. The notification states that the application printout facility depends on successful fee adjustment.

content_sections.heading: UPSSSC Junior Engineer Mechanical Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must satisfy both the UPSSSC PET 2025 requirement and the educational qualifications prescribed for their selected post. The notification includes separate technical qualifications and equivalent diploma disciplines for different departments. Candidates must have participated in the Preliminary Eligibility Test (PET) 2025. A PET 2025 scorecard must have been issued by the Commission. Shortlisting for the main examination will be based on normalized PET 2025 scores. Candidates with zero or negative normalized scores will not be shortlisted. Candidates whose PET 2025 results are provisionally marked or under investigation may be considered subject to the Commission's stated conditions. The recruitment includes posts requiring relevant technical, engineering and diploma qualifications. The exact requirements depend on the department and post. The supporting departmental documents include several Mechanical Engineering and related diploma disciplines, such as: Mechanical Engineering Mechanical Engineering (Production) Mechanical Engineering (Maintenance) Mechanical Engineering (Automobile) Mechanical Engineering (Tool Engineering) Mechanical Engineering (CAD/CAM) Mechanical Engineering (Refrigeration and Air Conditioning) Production Engineering Manufacturing Engineering Tool and Die Engineering Mechatronics Robotics and Mechatronics Important: Inclusion of a discipline in an equivalence list does not mean it is accepted for every advertised post. The applicable department, post and relevant qualification order must be checked in the official notification.
